decisions: a0 is a provider, not an agent: clients own the agent loop
a0 modifies every request with an idempotent operating contract (enhancement on by default)
capability gates are hard: no tools to chat-only lanes, no images to text-only lanes
race=2 by default (first usable byte wins, loser aborted); best-of available for non-stream, default off
streaming is the contract; no retry after bytes are sent
loopback by default; a token is auto-generated when binding beyond loopback
setup leads with keyed free-tier providers (Kilo, xKiro, Groq, Z.ai); OpenRouter, MiMo, Alibaba, OpenAI, Gemini are optional
adding any key switches to keyed mode and disables anonymous lanes; keeping them as fallback is opt-in
per-model selection is stored as a disabled array per provider, only for lanes with a key; anonymous-pool models stay curated
updates are check-only by default (once a day, non-blocking); a0 update installs; auto-install is opt-in
updater targets a0-gateway, never the unrelated a0 package
npm package is a0-gateway; the command remains a0
